clue.text: Constituency defeat for relative of Salmond (almost — or, more distantly, Sturgeon)

definitions.text: relative of Salmond (almost — or, more distantly, Sturgeon)

parts.note: a constituency is an electoral seat
a rout is a crushing defeat

explanation.surface: Alex Salmond losing his seat at an election, with a nod to his successor Nicola Sturgeon, both Scottish National Party leaders.
explanation.walkthrough: Salmond 'almost' is SALMON, so the definition is a fish close kin to salmon; the sturgeon is a more distant fishy relation. Salmond and Sturgeon are former Scottish first ministers.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea trout is a migratory form of brown trout, a close cousin of the salmon in the same fish family.

clue.text: Trick to get large bakery products to rise

indicators.note: in a down answer, rising means the words large and bakery products are read from the bottom up

parts.note: mega is slang for very large
tarts are pastries sold by bakers

explanation.surface: A baker's ruse to make huge pastries puff up in the oven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to rise' looks like dough rising but turns MEGATARTS upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A stratagem is a cunning plan or ruse, a synonym of a trick.

clue.text: Extremely awe-inspiring, terrifying woman blowing top in attack

indicators.note: the extreme letters of a word are its first and last, here of awe-inspiring
losing its top letter in a down answer, so the first letter of the synonym goes

parts.note: an ogress is a frightening female monster

explanation.surface: A fearsome woman loses her temper and lashes out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blowing top' suggests rage but removes the O of OGRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: To aggress is a rare verb meaning to make an attack or act aggressively.

clue.text: Estimated speed: 500

parts.note: rate is speed, as in a rate of knots
D is the Roman numeral for 500

explanation.surface: A rough guess of velocity: five hundred.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rated has been assessed or valued, a synonym of estimated.

clue.text: With a lifting of phone, changing social network status for the better

definitions.text: changing social network status for the better

parts.note: done with a lifting motion means done upwardly
a mobile is a cellphone

explanation.surface: Raising your phone to update your social media status.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social network status' reads as an online profile, but the definition is about class: moving up the social ladder.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone upwardly mobile is climbing to a higher class or position in society.

clue.text: Runs from British city

parts.note: Leeds is a city in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Someone fleeing a British city.
explanation.definitionFit: Colours or dyes that bleed spread or run, so the two verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Men involved with mob, all producing herb

indicators.note: involved means entangled, so the letters of men, mob and all are mixed together

explanation.surface: Gang members tangled up with the mob, all growing something illicit.
explanation.definitionFit: Lemon balm is a lemon-scented plant of the mint family used as a culinary and medicinal herb.

clue.text: Peer's decoration that may hang by his sideboard

definitions.text: Peer's decoration that may hang by his sideboard

parts.note: an earl is a British peer
the OBE is a British honour, Officer of the Order of the British Empire

explanation.surface: A nobleman's medal displayed near his furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sideboard' is not furniture but a sideburn, so the whole clue describes a part of the head hanging beside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The lobe of the ear hangs just below where sideburns, also called sideboards, grow.

clue.text: Mounting sexual desire, unconsummated, ends in kiss and display of resentment

indicators.note: in a down answer, mounting means climbing, so the trimmed desire is read upwards
not completed, so the final letter of the synonym is left off

parts.note: lust is sexual desire

indicators.note: the ends of a word are its first and last letters, here of kiss

explanation.surface: Frustrated passion that never goes beyond a kiss leaves someone peevish.
explanation.definitionFit: A fit of the sulks is a sullen, silent show of being put out.

clue.text: One's power to infiltrate hyperstores deviously

definitions.text: One's power to infiltrate hyperstores deviously

parts.note: one's, spoken by the speaker, means my

indicators.note: infiltrating means getting inside, so power goes within the jumbled letters
a devious route twists about, so the letters of hyperstores are rearranged

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: Someone's ability to slip undercover into big superstores.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deviously' rearranges HYPERSTORES to STERYSHOPER, and 'to infiltrate' puts P inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A mystery shopper poses as an ordinary customer to assess a store's service secretly.

clue.text: What'll get you cash from crash immediately

definitions.text: What'll get you cash from crash
definitions.meaning: taking R, short for ... from the word crash leaves cash

explanation.surface: Someone wants quick money out of a market collapse.
explanation.walkthrough: R is a standard abbreviation for right; remove it from 'crash' and you get 'cash'.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something at once means doing it without any delay at all.

clue.text: What's drawn up Russian river by mule at first

indicators.note: by means next to, so the mule's letter stands beside the river
at first picks the opening letter of mule

parts.note: the Ural is a river in Russia

explanation.surface: Something hauled upstream along a Russian river by a mule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawn' suggests hauled, as by a mule, but means painted or sketched.
explanation.definitionFit: A mural is a painting or drawing made directly on a wall.

clue.text: Dawn one's come across in Lewis as one's walking

definitions.text: Dawn one's come across in Lewis
definitions.meaning: C.S. Lewis wrote The Voyage of the Dawn ..., the ship in his Narnia stories
someone who steps along on foot

explanation.surface: A woman named Dawn met on the Isle of Lewis, out for a stroll.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lewis' suggests the Hebridean island but means the author C.S. Lewis.
explanation.definitionFit: A treader is a person who treads, that is, steps or walks.

clue.text: Injuries to these might see faculty XI reduced?

definitions.text: Injuries to these might see faculty XI reduced?

parts.words: Injuries to these might see faculty XI reduced?
parts.note: a faculty eleven is a team of eleven university dons; losing a player leaves ten of them

explanation.surface: A university staff cricket team weakened by players' injuries.
explanation.walkthrough: Dons are university lecturers; read the answer as TEN DONS, what an eleven of dons becomes when one is injured.
explanation.definitionFit: Tendons are the tough cords joining muscles to bones, and their injuries often sideline sports players.

clue.text: Preacher's words of encouragement for one involved with bees?

definitions.meaning: an evangelist who reads or spreads the gospels

definitions.text: words of encouragement for one involved with bees?
definitions.meaning: a contestant in a spelling bee might be cheered on with '...!'

explanation.surface: A minister's pep talk for a beekeeper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bees' means spelling bees, not insects.
explanation.definitionFit: A gospeller is an evangelist or the cleric who reads the gospel at a service.

clue.text: Cover Muslim festival with wonder, shaken

parts.note: Eid is a Muslim festival, such as Eid al-Fitr

indicators.note: shaken up, the letters of wonder are rearranged

explanation.surface: Celebrating a Muslim festival with awe, all shaken up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shaken' rearranges WONDER to ERDOWN.
explanation.definitionFit: An eiderdown is a quilt used as a bed covering.

clue.text: Ridge etc — find what's missing on the way back

indicators.note: going back means the missing letters are read in reverse
asks for the letters of the full phrase that the short form leaves out

parts.note: etc is short for et cetera

explanation.surface: A mountain ridge and so on, with a hiker retracing steps to find something lost.
explanation.walkthrough: The abbreviation ETC drops ETERA from ET CETERA; 'on the way back' turns ETERA round.
explanation.definitionFit: An arete is a sharp mountain crest between two glacial valleys.

clue.text: A helper flapping when taking care of me will be short-lived

indicators.note: taking care of someone means holding them in safekeeping, so me goes within
in a flap means in a panic, so the letters of a helper are scrambled

explanation.surface: A flustered carer looking after the speaker won't last long.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flapping' rearranges A HELPER to EPHERAL, and 'when taking care of' puts ME inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ephemeral lasts only a very brief time, a synonym for transient.

clue.text: Did low feelings with little energy set in?

indicators.note: placed inside, so the energy letter sits within the feelings

parts.note: a mood is a state of feeling
E is the abbreviation for energy, little as in short form

explanation.surface: Asking whether depression arrived along with tiredness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'low' looks like a feeling but is the cow's verb, to moo.
explanation.definitionFit: Cattle low, meaning they moo, so making that sound in the past tense fits.

clue.text: Monitoring substance picked up when American comes in after performing

indicators.note: after places the guarded substance behind the performing word

parts.note: an actor performing is on stage

indicators.note: comes in means enters, so the American letter goes inside
in a down answer, picked up means lifted, so the substance is read upwards

parts.note: a drug is a substance

explanation.surface: An American performer taking a substance while being watched.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked up' sounds like a homophone signal, but here it turns DRUG upwards to GURD.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on guard means keeping watch, alert and watchful for danger.

clue.text: Muscular type's yours truly — emphatically yours truly!

parts.note: yours truly is the speaker, me
so, as in 'I so am', adds emphasis
the setter of this puzzle signs as Morph

explanation.surface: A setter boasting about being a muscleman.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'yours truly' means the setter, whose pseudonym is Morph.
explanation.definitionFit: A mesomorph has a compact, muscular body build in the old somatotype classification.

clue.text: Lives on the margins

parts.note: re means on or about, as in a letter heading
the sides of a page are its margins

explanation.surface: Someone living at the edge of society.
explanation.definitionFit: To reside somewhere is to live or dwell there.

clue.text: Arab region where hamburger's cooked, not with pure meat

indicators.note: cooked means altered or fiddled, so the letters of hamburger are reworked, leaving out the pure meat
the meat of something is its core, so the inner letters of pure are taken

explanation.surface: A place where burgers are fried that don't use pure beef.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meat' is the filling of a word, not beef; 'not with' tells you those inner letters are left out of the cooked burger.
explanation.definitionFit: The Maghreb is northwest Africa, the Arabic-speaking area of Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia.

clue.text: Excellent spelling!

definitions.meaning: wonderful, as in an exclamation of delight

explanation.surface: Praise for someone who spelt a word correctly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spelling' looks like orthography but means working spells.
explanation.definitionFit: Magic is both slang for wonderful and the practice of casting spells and enchantments.

clue.text: Marsupial's drunk some unfinished soup

indicators.note: drunk means tipsy and confused, so the letters are jumbled
not completed, so the last letter of some is dropped

explanation.surface: An animal has slurped up part of a bowl of soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfinished' cuts SOME to SOM, which with SOUP is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The opossum is an American marsupial that carries young in a pouch.

clue.text: United in revolt and having advantage

parts.note: united means made one
a people up in arms have risen up

explanation.surface: A people joined together in rebellion gain the upper hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Being one up means holding a lead or an edge over a rival.

clue.text: Dropping of wingers may improve performance on field

definitions.text: Dropping of wingers may improve performance on field

parts.words: Dropping of wingers may improve performance on field
parts.note: wingers are birds and their dropping is a manure; the field is farmland, not a sports pitch

explanation.surface: A football manager benching wide players to get a better result.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wingers' and 'field' suggest football, but the clue means birds and crops.
explanation.definitionFit: Guano is the excrement of seabirds or bats, prized as a rich fertiliser.

clue.text: I see what you're saying — boss controls Independent public relations

indicators.note: controls means holds, so the boss surrounds the other letters

parts.note: a leader is the boss

explanation.surface: A newspaper editor approving the press office's message.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is spoken by someone who understands speech by watching mouths.
explanation.definitionFit: A lip-reader understands speech by watching the mouth, literally seeing words spoken.

clue.text: Programming company's sound as a bell

parts.note: ding is the ringing noise a bell makes

explanation.surface: A firm's software is in perfect order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound as a bell' reads as the idiom for healthy, but means a bell's noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Coding is writing instructions for computers, the craft of software.

clue.text: Suggestion for partner in which love is involved

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for

indicators.note: involved means wrapped up within, so the love letters go inside the partner

parts.note: a pal is a friend or partner
love is zero in tennis, like the letter O
is shortens to 's

explanation.surface: An offer of marriage to a sweetheart, full of romance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Suggestion for partner' reads as the marriage offer, but only 'Suggestion' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposal is a plan or scheme put forward for consideration.
